message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** that are based on federal public holidays (the ones that apply nationwide).  
For each entry I’ve included the start and end dates of the long weekend, the holiday(s) that create it, and a short note about any “observed” dates (when a holiday falls on a weekend and is moved to the nearest weekday).

| Long‑Weekend Start | Long‑Weekend End | Holiday(s) that create it | Notes |
|--------------------|------------------|---------------------------|-------|
| **Dec 30 2022** | **Jan 2 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday Jan 1; observed on Monday Jan 2. |
| **Feb 18 2023** | **Feb 20 2023** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Third Monday in February. |
| **Apr 7 2023** | **Apr 10 2023** | Good Friday & Easter Monday | Good Friday (Friday Apr 7) + Easter Monday (Monday Apr 10). |
| **May 20 2023** | **May 22 2023** | Victoria Day | Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1 2023** | **Jul 3 2023** | Canada Day (observed) | Canada Day fell on Saturday Jul 1; observed on Monday Jul 3. |
| **Sep 2 2023** | **Sep 4 2023** | Labour Day | First Monday in September. |
| **Oct 7 2023** | **Oct 9 2023** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October. |
| **Nov 11 2023** | **Nov 13 2023** | Remembrance Day | Remembrance Day fell on Friday Nov 11. |
| **Dec 23 2023** | **Dec 25 2023** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day fell on Monday Dec 25. |

### How to use this data

If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, you can store this list as a JSON array, e.g.:

```json
[
  {
    "start": "2022-12-30",
    "end":   "2023-01-02",
    "holidays": ["New Year's Day (observed)"]
  },
  {
    "start": "2023-02-18",
    "end":   "2023-02-20",
    "holidays": ["Family Day"]
  },
  ...
]
```

Feel free to adjust the list if you need province‑specific holidays (e.g., Family Day in British Columbia, St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.). If you’d like a more detailed breakdown or additional holidays, let me know!
